source: ERDA test report RP-2526-026098, issued 2025-11-17; report-specific recommended action limits (IS 1866:2017 oil tests). Validate applicability with the responsible electrical engineer before using for operational decisions.
interval_policy: Initial intervals: BDV every 6 months and other oil tests every 3 months as requested by the application owner; DGA annually and furan every 24 months follow retest comments in this sample report. Confirm and edit before operational use.

parameters.name: Breakdown Voltage
parameters.reference: Good: >40 kV; Fair: 30-40 kV; Poor: <30 kV (report, IS 1866:2017).

parameters.name: Water Content
parameters.reference: Good: <30 mg/kg; Fair: 30-40 mg/kg; Poor: >40 mg/kg (report, IS 1866:2017).

parameters.name: Acidity (Neutralization Value)
parameters.reference: Good: <0.15; Fair: 0.15-0.30; Poor: >0.30 mg KOH/g (report, IS 1866:2017).

parameters.name: Resistivity at 90°C
parameters.reference: Good: >3 GΩ·m; Fair: 0.2-3 GΩ·m; Poor: <0.2 GΩ·m (report, IS 1866:2017).

parameters.name: Sediment and Sludge
parameters.reference: Requirement: no sediment or precipitable sludge. The report notes results below 0.02% by mass may be neglected; values outside that note need engineering review.

parameters.name: Interfacial Tension at 25°C
parameters.reference: Good: >25 mN/m; Fair: 20-25 mN/m; Poor: <20 mN/m (report, IS 1866:2017).

parameters.name: Flash Point
parameters.reference: Minimum 144°C (report, IS 1866:2017).
